items.q: Stan Getz did it for a number of years and he only loused himself up.

ctx.x: Yeah, Jimmy. I could go back a little further than that but right now I don't want to. Because I agree wholeheartedly with you that it has sort of a putdown name. Studio Musician. But the studio musician to me supplies all of the best musicians that came out of the big bands when the big bands were starting to disintegrate.
